# OCR fixture provenance

`presskit-ocr.json` is local Windows OCR output from `Fates_UI_2.png` in the
[GGG Covens of Umbra press kit](https://web.poecdn.com/public/news/2026-11-07/Kits_for_press_exc26/PoE1_CovensofUmbra_PressKit.zip),
inspected on 2026-11-07. Source image dimensions: 3840 × 2160.

The fixture contains text and bounding boxes only. It tests that the four offered
cards are kept while the Torchbearer in the collected deck below is excluded.
This is pre-release test evidence, not a live-game observation or probability sample.
Game names and text belong to Grinding Gear Games.
